fields.name_zh_en: Has he/she "ever" had asthma attacks or wheezing sounds from the chest when breathing?

fields.name_zh: "過去12個月"，他平均多久會因氣喘發作而中斷睡眠醒過來？

1:每星期少於一次,
2:每星期一次或多於一次,
3:不知道

fields.description_en: 0: Never, 1: Less than once a week, 2: Once a week or more, 3: Don't know

fields.name_zh_en: "In the past 12 months", has he/she had an asthma attack or breathing difficulty so severe that he/she could speak only 1 to 2 words between breaths?

fields.name_zh: 他過去是否"曾經"被醫師診斷有氣喘？
fields.name_zh_en: Has he/she "ever" been diagnosed with asthma by a physician?

fields.name_zh: "過去12個月"，他是否有活動或運動引發的咳嗽或氣喘？

3:因化學品點燃所導致火焰燒傷,

6:長期暴露在檯燈燈光下造成表皮燒燙傷,
7:接觸使用中或剛使用完畢的檯燈燈罩造成表皮燒燙傷,
8:過於接近燒金爐或接觸到其未燃燒完全的灰燼而燒燙傷,
9:接觸到機車排氣管,
10:接觸到加熱之鍋具.爐具或茶壺,
11:無法分類

fields.description_zh:

fields.description_zh:
1:從來不會, 2:很少會, 3:有時會,
4:總是會, 5:不外出

fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Rarely, 3: Sometimes, 4: Always, 5: Does not go out

fields.description_zh:
1:從來不會, 2:很少會, 3:有時會,
4:總是會
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year," when he had a cough "and" fever, other than seeing a doctor, would he still go to school or go out?

fields.description_en:

3: Every time, 4: Rarely or no longer drinks milk

4:不知道算不算剛好

9:接觸到機車排氣管, 10:接觸到加熱之鍋具、爐具或茶壺, 11:無法分類

fields.description_en: 1: Scalded by hot water, liquid, or steam, 2: Contact with acid, alkali, or corrosive chemicals, 3: Burned by flames from ignited chemicals, 4: Burned by ignited flammable liquid (gasoline, kerosene, or other combustible liquid), 5: Scalded from using or touching a used electric blanket or other electrical appliance, 6: Skin burn from prolonged exposure to lamp light, 7: Skin burn from contact with a lamp shade in use or just used, 8: Burned from being too close to a joss paper burning furnace or contact with its unburned ashes, 9: Contact with a motorcycle exhaust pipe, 10: Contact with a heated pot, stove, or kettle, 11: Unclassifiable

fields.name_zh_en: Why don't you have a job?
fields.description_en: 1: Homemaker, 2: Student, 3: Unable to work, 4: Other reasons

fields.name_zh: 後來為什麼沒有在工作了呢?
fields.description_zh:
1:退休或年紀大了, 2:健康的問題，不能繼續工作, 3:工作不適應,
4:公司裁員或關閉遷移等，被遣散, 5:收入不滿意,
6:生意失敗/經濟不景氣，利潤太差,
7:學生,
8:家庭因素：結婚或照顧家裡小孩子的關係, 9:其他因素
fields.name_zh_en: Why did you later stop working?
fields.description_en: 1: Retired or too old, 2: Health problems, unable to continue working, 3: Not suited to the job, 4: Laid off due to company downsizing/closure/relocation, 5: Dissatisfied with income, 6: Business failure/economic downturn, poor profits, 7: Student, 8: Family reasons: marriage or caring for children at home, 9: Other reasons

fields.name_zh: 請問您目前有幾個工作？（包括主、副業）
fields.name_zh_en: How many jobs do you currently have? (Including main and side jobs)

fields.name_zh: 請問您目前的"主要"工作狀況？
fields.description_zh: 1:全時間工作, 2:部分時間工作, 3:學生, 4:其他
fields.name_zh_en: What is your current "main" work status?
fields.description_en: 1: Full-time work, 2: Part-time work, 3: Student, 4: Other

fields.name_zh: 您的"主要"工作是屬於政府雇用、民間雇用、自己就是雇主也有員工，或是沒有員工的自營事業?【請一併記錄於訪問狀況紀錄表】
fields.description_zh: 1:政府雇用, 2:民間雇用, 3:自營(下無員工), 4:雇主 (下有員工)
fields.name_zh_en: Is your "main" job government employment, private employment, self-employed with employees, or self-employed without employees? [Please also record on the interview status form]
fields.description_en: 1: Government employed, 2: Privately employed, 3: Self-employed (no employees), 4: Employer (has employees)

fields.name_zh: 您是否經銓敍部銓敍審定？【請一併記錄於訪問狀況紀錄表】
fields.name_zh_en: Have you been reviewed/certified by the Ministry of Civil Service? [Please also record this in the interview status record form]

fields.name_zh: 您這份主要工作，共雇用多少員工？【請一併記錄於訪問狀況紀錄表】
fields.name_zh_en: How many employees in total does the employer of your main job have? [Please also record on the interview status form]
fields.description_en: 1: Fewer than 30 people, 2: 30 or more people

fields.name_zh: 請問您平常"每週"工作幾個小時？（包括主、副業，但排除通勤時間）
fields.name_zh_en: How many hours do you usually work per week? (Including main and secondary jobs, excluding commuting time)

fields.name_zh: 您"最近一個月"有無參加全民健保？
fields.description_zh: 0:從未加入健保, 1:有參加健保, 2:中斷投保, 3:其他
fields.name_zh_en: Have you enrolled in National Health Insurance "in the past month"?
fields.description_en: 0: Never enrolled in NHI, 1: Enrolled in NHI, 2: Coverage interrupted, 3: Other

fields.name_zh: 雇主拒絕辦投保
fields.name_zh_en: employer refusal to enroll in insurance

fields.name_zh: 收入不穩或太少
fields.name_zh_en: income stability or too low

fields.name_zh: 失業
fields.name_zh_en: unemployment

fields.name_zh: 不知有全民健保
fields.name_zh_en: Known to have National Health Insurance

fields.name_zh: 不知如何投保
fields.name_zh_en: how to insure

fields.name_zh: 積欠保費不敢投保
fields.name_zh_en: backlogged premium unable to insure

fields.name_zh: 覺得保費太貴
fields.name_zh_en: find insurance premium too expensive

fields.name_zh: 已有其他商業保險
fields.name_zh_en: already have other commercial insurance

fields.name_zh: 工作轉換尚未投保
fields.name_zh_en: not insured after job change

fields.name_zh: 身體健康不需投保
fields.name_zh_en: need insurance for physical health

fields.name_zh: 長期出國
fields.name_zh_en: long-term travel abroad

fields.name_zh: 受刑人
fields.name_zh_en: prisoner

fields.name_zh: 家庭因素(例如：家長或可依附投保之家人失和/離異/去世)
fields.name_zh_en: Family factors (e.g., estrangement/divorce/death of parent or family member eligible for dependent insurance coverage)

fields.name_zh: 其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: other reasons

fields.name_zh: "過去一年"，您"平均一個月"的收入（包括薪資、租金、投資所得、子女給的、父母給的、社會救助、退休金等），大約有多少？
fields.description_zh:
0:沒有收入, 1:未滿5千元, 2:5千元～未滿1萬元, 3:1萬元～未滿1萬5千元,
4:1萬5千元～未滿2萬元, 5:2萬元～未滿4萬元, 6:4萬元～未滿6萬元,
7:6萬元～未滿8萬元, 8:8萬元～未滿10萬元, 9:10萬元及以上
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", about how much was your income "per month on average" (including salary, rent, investment income, money from children, money from parents, social assistance, pension, etc.)?
fields.description_en:
0: No income, 1: Less than 5,000 yuan, 2: 5,000 to less than 10,000 yuan, 3: 10,000 to less than 15,000 yuan,
4: 15,000 to less than 20,000 yuan, 5: 20,000 to less than 40,000 yuan, 6: 40,000 to less than 60,000 yuan,
7: 60,000 to less than 80,000 yuan, 8: 80,000 to less than 100,000 yuan, 9: 100,000 yuan or more

fields.name_zh: "過去一年"，您"家中的收入"全部算在一起(包括薪資、租金、投資所得、子女給予、父母給予、社會救助、退休金等)，"平均一個月"大約有多少？【若父母、子女給予，如還住同一戶不要重複算入】
fields.description_zh:
1:未滿3萬元, 2:3萬元～未滿5萬元,
3:5萬元～未滿7萬元,
4:7萬元～未滿10萬元, 5:10萬元～未滿15萬元, 6:15萬元～未滿20萬元,
7:20萬元及以上
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year," what was your "household income," combining all sources (including salary, rent, investment income, money given by children, money given by parents, social assistance, pension, etc.), on average "per month"? [If money given by parents/children who live in the same household, do not double-count]
fields.description_en:
1: Less than 30,000 yuan, 2: 30,000 to less than 50,000 yuan,
3: 50,000 to less than 70,000 yuan,
4: 70,000 to less than 100,000 yuan, 5: 100,000 to less than 150,000 yuan, 6: 150,000 to less than 200,000 yuan,
7: 200,000 yuan or more

fields.name_zh: 請問您目前有沒有一支或一支以上有效的手機門號？（以過去一個月有撥打，且現在沒有停話的門號為準）
fields.name_zh_en: Do you currently have one or more active mobile phone numbers? (Based on numbers used to make calls in the past month that are not currently disconnected)

fields.name_zh: 過去一個月，請問您總共使用多少支手機門號？
fields.name_zh_en: In the past month, how many mobile phone numbers did you use in total?

fields.name_zh: 請問您家中現在有沒有至少一支以上可以使用的"家用電話號碼"？(不包括手機、傳真或上網專用電話)
fields.name_zh_en: Does your household currently have at least one usable "home phone number"? (Excluding mobile phones, fax, or internet-only lines)

fields.name_zh: 【訪員查核】O1-O4節需樣本個案本人回答，請確認受訪者是否為樣本個案本人
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Sections O1-O4 must be answered by the sample case in person; please confirm whether the respondent is the sample case him/herself

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得不想吃東西、胃口不好【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you not feel like eating or have a poor appetite? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得心情很不好、鬱悶【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel very down or depressed? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得事情總是不太順利【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel that things were not going well? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得睡不安穩(不入眠)【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week", have you felt that you slept restlessly (could not fall asleep)? [Respondent only; if not the respondent, select the special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得很快樂【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel very happy? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得寂寞、孤單【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel lonely or isolated? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得別人都不友善【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel that others were all unfriendly toward you? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得日子過的很好，享受人生【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel that life was going well and that you were enjoying life? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得傷心、悲哀【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel sad or sorrowful? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: "過去一週內"，您會不會覺得提不起勁來做任何事【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 0:從不或很少(少於1天), 1:有時候(1~2天), 2:常常(3~4天), 3:幾乎一直是(5~7天)
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past week," did you feel unmotivated to do anything? [Respondent must answer in person; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 0: Never or rarely (less than 1 day), 1: Sometimes (1-2 days), 2: Often (3-4 days), 3: Almost always (5-7 days)

fields.name_zh: 詢問個案是否願意繼續填寫自填問卷：
fields.name_zh_en: Ask the case whether willing to continue filling out the self-administered questionnaire:

fields.name_zh: 【訪員查核】個案無法自行填寫自填問卷的原因？
fields.description_zh:
1:不識字, 2:個案拒填, 3:重病或身體虛弱體力無法支持, 4:家人拒絕讓個案填寫,
5:失明, 6:老花眼, 7:不會使用電腦,
8:家人干擾作答
fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Reason the case is unable to complete the self-administered questionnaire?
fields.description_en: 1: Illiterate, 2: Subject refused to fill it out, 3: Seriously ill or too physically weak, 4: Family refused to let the subject fill it out, 5: Blind, 6: Presbyopia, 7: Cannot use a computer, 8: Family interfered with answering

fields.name_zh: 瞭解在發生緊急醫療狀況時該做些什麼？【本題為測試題，不納入資料收集，請帶著受測者操作】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常困難, 2:有點困難, 3:還算容易, 4:非常容易, 5:不清楚
fields.name_zh_en: Understand what to do in a medical emergency? [This is a test item, not included in data collection; guide the respondent through it]
fields.description_en: 1: Very difficult, 2: Somewhat difficult, 3: Fairly easy, 4: Very easy, 5: Unclear

fields.name_zh: 找到如何預防或控制體重過重、血壓高或高膽固醇等情況的資訊？【本題為測試題，不納入資料收集，請帶著受測者操作】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常困難, 2:有點困難, 3:還算容易, 4:非常容易, 5:不清楚
fields.name_zh_en: Find information on how to prevent or control conditions such as being overweight, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol? [This is a test question, not included in data collection; please guide the respondent through the operation]
fields.description_en: 1: Very difficult, 2: Somewhat difficult, 3: Fairly easy, 4: Very easy, 5: Unclear

fields.name_zh: 您滿意您目前的生活嗎？【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常滿意, 2:滿意, 3:普通, 4:不滿意, 5:非常不滿意
fields.name_zh_en: Are you satisfied with your current life? [Self-response only; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 1: Very satisfied, 2: Satisfied, 3: Fair, 4: Dissatisfied, 5: Very dissatisfied

fields.name_zh: 針對此情緒形容詞"《難過的》"，請您評估自己在過去一個月中，有多常經驗到這情緒。【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Regarding this emotional descriptor "《sad》", please assess how often you experienced this feeling over the past month. [Respondent only; select the special code if not answered by the respondent]

fields.name_zh: 針對此情緒形容詞"《滿足的》"，請您評估自己在過去一個月中，有多常經驗到這情緒。【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: For this emotion word "《Content》", please assess how often you experienced this emotion in the past month. [Respondent only; if not the respondent, select the special code]

fields.name_zh: 針對此情緒形容詞"《您的內心是輕鬆自在的》"，請您評估自己在過去一個月中，有多常經驗到這情緒。【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.name_zh_en: Regarding this emotional descriptor "《feeling relaxed and at ease》", please assess how often you experienced this feeling over the past month. [Respondent only; select the special code if not answered by the respondent]

fields.name_zh: 您善於運用自己的時間，因此您可以完成需要完成的事【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:尚可, 4:不同意, 5:非常不同意
fields.name_zh_en: You are good at managing your time, so you can accomplish what needs to be done 【Respondent only; if not the respondent, select the special code】
fields.description_en: 1: Strongly agree, 2: Agree, 3: Neutral, 4: Disagree, 5: Strongly disagree

fields.name_zh: 隨著年紀增長，您覺得自己成熟不少【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:尚可, 4:不同意, 5:非常不同意
fields.name_zh_en: As you have grown older, do you feel you have matured considerably? [Respondent only; select the special code if not answered by the respondent]
fields.description_en: 1: Strongly agree, 2: Agree, 3: Neutral, 4: Disagree, 5: Strongly disagree

fields.name_zh: 您是一個積極實現自己計畫的人【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:尚可, 4:不同意, 5:非常不同意
fields.name_zh_en: You are a person who actively carries out your own plans [Self-response only; if not the respondent, select special code]
fields.description_en: 1: Strongly agree, 2: Agree, 3: Neutral, 4: Disagree, 5: Strongly disagree

fields.name_zh: 您和朋友之間能彼此信任【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常同意, 2:同意, 3:尚可, 4:不同意, 5:非常不同意
fields.name_zh_en: You and your friends can trust each other 【Respondent only; if not the respondent, select the special code】
fields.description_en: 1: Strongly agree, 2: Agree, 3: Neutral, 4: Disagree, 5: Strongly disagree

fields.name_zh: 與朋友和認識的人相比時，您對自己感到滿意【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常滿意, 2:滿意, 3:普通, 4:不滿意, 5:非常不滿意
fields.name_zh_en: Compared to friends and acquaintances, you are satisfied with yourself [Self-report only; if not self, select special code]
fields.description_en: 1: Very satisfied, 2: Satisfied, 3: Fair, 4: Dissatisfied, 5: Very dissatisfied

fields.name_zh: 重要家人與您平時的相處情形是【限本人回答，非本人請點選特殊碼】
fields.description_zh: 1:非常融洽, 2:融洽, 3:普通, 4:不融洽, 5:非常不融洽
fields.name_zh_en: How do you usually get along with important family members [Person only; if not the person, select the special code]
fields.description_en: 1: Very harmonious, 2: Harmonious, 3: Fair, 4: Not harmonious, 5: Very disharmonious

fields.description_zh: 0:沒有困難, 1:有些困難, 2:非常困難, 3:完全不能做
fields.name_zh_en: "Without anyone's help and without using assistive devices", do you have difficulty, due to "aging or health problems", using the telephone "on your own" (able to dial and answer calls completely)?
fields.description_en: 0: No difficulty, 1: Some difficulty, 2: Very difficult, 3: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問在「"沒有人幫忙，也沒有使用器具輔助"」的情況下，是否因"老化或健康問題"而使您"獨自"服用藥物（可自行按時正確吃藥）有困難？
fields.description_zh: 0:沒有困難, 1:有些困難, 2:非常困難, 3:完全不能做
fields.name_zh_en: "Without anyone's help and without using assistive devices", do you have difficulty, due to "aging or health problems", taking medication "on your own" (taking medicine correctly on time by yourself)?
fields.description_en: 0: No difficulty, 1: Some difficulty, 2: Very difficult, 3: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問在「"沒有人幫忙，也沒有使用器具輔助"」的情況下，是否因"老化或健康問題"而使您"獨自"做輕鬆家務(如洗碗、燙衣服、倒垃圾等)有困難？
fields.description_zh: 0:沒有困難, 1:有些困難, 2:非常困難, 3:完全不能做
fields.name_zh_en: "Without anyone's help and without using assistive devices", do you have difficulty, due to "aging or health problems", "doing light housework (e.g., washing dishes, ironing clothes, taking out the trash)" "on your own"?
fields.description_en: 0: No difficulty, 1: Some difficulty, 2: Very difficult, 3: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問在「"沒有人幫忙，也沒有使用器具輔助"」的情況下，是否因"老化或健康問題"而使您"獨自"洗衣服有困難？
fields.description_zh: 0:沒有困難, 1:有些困難, 2:非常困難, 3:完全不能做
fields.name_zh_en: Without "anyone's help or the use of assistive devices", do you have difficulty doing laundry "on your own" because of "aging or health problems"?
fields.description_en: 0: No difficulty, 1: Some difficulty, 2: Very difficult, 3: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問在「"沒有人幫忙，也沒有使用器具輔助"」的情況下，是否因"老化或健康問題"而使您"獨自"打掃家裡(指較粗重的家務，包括擦窗戶、擦地等)有困難？
fields.description_zh: 0:沒有困難, 1:有些困難, 2:非常困難, 3:完全不能做
fields.name_zh_en: "Without anyone's help and without using assistive devices", do you have difficulty, due to "aging or health problems", "cleaning the house (heavier housework, including wiping windows and mopping floors)" "on your own"?
fields.description_en: 0: No difficulty, 1: Some difficulty, 2: Very difficult, 3: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問在「"沒有人幫忙，也沒有使用器具輔助"」的情況下，是否因"老化或健康問題"而使您"獨自"理財(清楚並且可以掌管自己的金錢)有困難？
fields.description_zh: 0:沒有困難, 1:有些困難, 2:非常困難, 3:完全不能做
fields.name_zh_en: "Without anyone's help and without using assistive devices", do you have difficulty, due to "aging or health problems", managing money "on your own" (understanding and being able to handle your own money)?
fields.description_en: 0: No difficulty, 1: Some difficulty, 2: Very difficult, 3: Cannot do at all

fields.name_zh: 請問您平常有沒有使用助聽器？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you usually use a hearing aid?

fields.name_zh: 請問您多常使用助聽器？是總是使用？有時使用？很少使用？
fields.description_zh: 1:總是使用, 2:有時使用, 3:很少使用
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you use a hearing aid? Always, sometimes, or rarely?
fields.description_en: 1: Always uses, 2: Sometimes uses, 3: Rarely uses

fields.name_zh: 請問您聽聲音有困難嗎？即使是在有使用助聽器的情況。
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全聽不見
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty hearing sounds? Even when using a hearing aid.
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 請問您在一間安靜的房間與人說話時，聽聲音會有困難嗎？即使是在有使用助聽器的情況下。
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全聽不見
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty hearing when talking with someone in a quiet room, even when using a hearing aid?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 請問您在一間較吵的房間與人說話時，聽聲音會有困難嗎？即使是在有使用助聽器的情況下。
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全聽不見
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty hearing when talking with someone in a noisier room, even when using a hearing aid?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 請問您聽聲音有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全聽不見
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty hearing sounds?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 請問您在一間安靜的房間與人說話時，聽聲音會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全聽不見
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty hearing when talking with someone in a quiet room?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 請問您在一間較吵的房間與人說話時，聽聲音會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全聽不見
fields.name_zh_en: When talking to someone in a noisy room, do you have difficulty hearing?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely deaf

fields.name_zh: 請問您走路或爬樓梯有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty walking or climbing stairs?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 您需要使用輔具或他人幫助來四處走動嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you need an assistive device or the help of others to get around?

fields.name_zh: 您有使用柺杖或手杖嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use crutches or a cane?

fields.name_zh: 您有使用助行器嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use a walker?

fields.name_zh: 您有使用(支在腋下的)丁形柺杖嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use (underarm) forearm crutches?

fields.name_zh: 您有使用輪椅或電動代步車嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use a wheelchair or electric mobility scooter?

fields.name_zh: 您有使用義肢嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use a prosthesis?

fields.name_zh: 有他人協助您行走嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Does anyone help you walk?

fields.name_zh: 您有使用其他設備協助行走嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use other equipment to assist with walking?

fields.name_zh: 在"沒有"使用任何輔具、或幫助的情形下，您在平地上走100公尺(大約是小學操場半圈或一個街口的距離)會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: "Without" the use of any assistive devices or help, do you have difficulty walking 100 meters on level ground (about half a lap of an elementary school track or the distance of one block)?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 在"沒有"使用任何輔具、或幫助的情形下，您在平地上走500公尺(大約是小學操場兩圈半或五個街口的距離)會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: "Without" using any assistive device or help, would you have difficulty walking 500 meters on level ground (about two and a half laps of an elementary school track or five blocks)?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 請問您上或下12階樓梯會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty climbing up or down 12 steps of stairs?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 在"有使用"任何輔具、或幫助的情形下，您在平地上走100公尺(大約是小學操場半圈或一個街口的距離)會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: "With" the use of any assistive devices or help, do you have difficulty walking 100 meters on level ground (about half a lap of an elementary school track or the distance of one block)?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 在"有使用"任何輔具、或幫助的情形下，您在平地上走500公尺(大約是小學操場兩圈半或五個街口的距離)會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: "With" the use of any assistive devices or help, do you have difficulty walking 500 meters on level ground (about two and a half laps of an elementary school track or the distance of five blocks)?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 請問您說話是否有困難？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty speaking?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 您是否使用手語？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you use sign language?

fields.name_zh: 當您使用慣用的語言與別人溝通時，是否會有困難，例如：您了解別人說的或別人也了解您說的？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: When you communicate with others in your usual language, do you have any difficulty — for example, understanding what others say or having others understand what you say?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 請問您是否有記憶力上的困難或覺得沒有辦法專心？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have any memory difficulties or feel unable to concentrate?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 請問您是有記憶上的困難，還是沒有辦法專心，或是兩者都有困難呢？
fields.description_zh: 1:有記憶上的困難, 2:難以專心, 3:記憶、專注力都有困難
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty with memory, or trouble concentrating, or both?
fields.description_en: 1: Has difficulty with memory, 2: Has difficulty concentrating, 3: Has difficulty with both memory and concentration

fields.name_zh: 請問您多常有記憶力上的困難？是有時有？經常有？或是總是有困難？
fields.description_zh: 1:有時有困難, 2:經常有困難, 3:總是有困難
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you have difficulty with memory? Sometimes? Often? Or always?
fields.description_en: 1: Sometimes have difficulty, 2: Often have difficulty, 3: Always have difficulty

fields.name_zh: 請問您是在少數事情、許多事情、或是幾乎所有事情上都有記憶上的困難？
fields.description_zh: 1:少數事情, 2:許多事情, 3:幾乎所有事情
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have memory difficulties in a few things, many things, or almost everything?

fields.name_zh: 請問您在自我照顧上有困難嗎，例如吃飯、穿脫衣服、站立、室內走動、上廁所、洗澡？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty with self-care, such as eating, dressing/undressing, standing, walking indoors, using the toilet, bathing?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 請問您把一個裝滿2公升水的瓶子從腰間舉到眼睛高度會有困難嗎？
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty lifting a 2-liter bottle full of water from waist to eye level?
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 請問您使用手及手指有困難嗎？例如拿起小東西(像是一個鈕扣或鉛筆之類的)，或是打開、旋上容器與瓶子
fields.description_zh: 1:沒有困難, 2:有點困難, 3:相當困難, 4:完全做不到
fields.name_zh_en: Do you have difficulty using your hands and fingers? For example, picking up small objects (such as a button or pencil), or opening and closing containers and bottles
fields.description_en: 1: No difficulty, 2: Some difficulty, 3: Quite difficult, 4: Completely unable

fields.name_zh: 請問您多常會感到擔心、緊張或焦慮？
fields.description_zh: 1:每天, 2:每週, 3:每月, 4:一年中有幾次, 5:從來沒有
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you feel worried, nervous or anxious?
fields.description_en: 1: Every day, 2: Every week, 3: Every month, 4: A few times a year, 5: Never

fields.name_zh: 請問您有因為擔心、緊張或焦慮等情緒而服用藥物嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you take medication because of feelings such as worry, nervousness or anxiety?

fields.name_zh: 請您回想"最近一次"感到擔心、緊張或焦慮的情形，當時這些感覺有多強烈？
fields.description_zh:
1:有點擔心、緊張或焦慮, 2:非常擔心、緊張或焦慮,
3:介於有點與非常之間
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to "the most recent" time you felt worried, tense or anxious. How intense were these feelings at the time?
fields.description_en:
1: Somewhat worried, tense or anxious, 2: Very worried, tense or anxious,
3: Between somewhat and very

fields.name_zh: 請問您多常會感到憂鬱、沮喪？
fields.description_zh: 1:每天, 2:每週, 3:每月, 4:一年中有幾次, 5:從來沒有
fields.name_zh_en: How often do you feel depressed or dejected?
fields.description_en: 1: Every day, 2: Every week, 3: Every month, 4: A few times a year, 5: Never

fields.name_zh: 請問您有因為憂鬱、沮喪而服用藥物嗎？
fields.name_zh_en: Do you take medication because of depression or dejection?

fields.name_zh: 請您回想"最近一次"感到憂鬱、沮喪的情形，當時的感覺有多強？
fields.description_zh: 1:有點憂鬱、沮喪, 2:非常憂鬱、沮喪, 3:介於有點與非常之間
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to "the most recent" time you felt depressed or dejected. How strong was the feeling at the time?
fields.description_en: 1: Somewhat depressed or dejected, 2: Very depressed or dejected, 3: Between somewhat and very

fields.name_zh: 在"過去三個月內"，請問您多常感到疼痛？
fields.description_zh: 1:從來沒有, 2:有時候有, 3:多數日子有, 4:每天都有
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past three months", how often have you felt pain?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Sometimes, 3: Most days, 4: Every day

fields.name_zh: 請您回想"最近一次"感到疼痛的情形，當時感到疼痛的程度有多嚴重？
fields.description_zh: 1:有點痛, 2:非常痛, 3:介於有點與非常之間
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to "the most recent" time you felt pain. How severe was the pain at the time?
fields.description_en: 1: Somewhat painful, 2: Very painful, 3: Between somewhat and very

fields.name_zh: 在"過去三個月內"，請問您多常感到非常疲倦或精疲力盡？
fields.description_zh: 1:從來沒有, 2:有時候有, 3:多數日子有, 4:每天都有
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past three months", how often have you felt very tired or exhausted?
fields.description_en: 1: Never, 2: Sometimes, 3: Most days, 4: Every day

fields.name_zh: 請您回想"最近一次"感到非常疲倦或精疲力盡時的情形，當時它持續了多久？
fields.description_zh: 1:一天中的部份時間, 2:一天中的多數時間, 3:整天
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to "the most recent" time you felt very tired or exhausted. How long did it last?
fields.description_en: 1: Part of the day, 2: Most of the day, 3: All day

fields.name_zh: 請您回想"最近一次"感到疲倦時的情形，您覺得當時感到疲倦的程度是如何？
fields.description_zh: 1:有點疲倦, 2:非常疲倦, 3:介於有點與非常之間
fields.name_zh_en: Think back to "the most recent" time you felt tired. How tired did you feel at the time?
fields.description_en: 1: Somewhat tired, 2: Very tired, 3: Between somewhat and very

fields.name_zh: 在"過去一年內"，您是否曾經覺得自己因健康問題而需要接受醫學檢查或治療，但實際上卻沒有去？
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year," did you ever feel that you needed medical examination or treatment due to a health problem but did not actually go?
fields.description_en: 0: No, never, 1: Yes, it has happened before

fields.name_zh: 在"過去一年內"，您有幾次曾經覺得自己因健康問題而需要接受醫學檢查或治療，但實際上卻沒有去？
fields.name_zh_en: In "the past year", how many times did you feel you needed a medical examination or treatment because of a health problem but did not actually go?

fields.name_zh: 醫院或診所太遠，或交通不便
fields.name_zh_en: Hospital or clinic too far away, or inconvenient transportation

fields.name_zh: 負擔不起
fields.name_zh_en: Cannot afford it

fields.name_zh: 等候掛號或看診的時間太久
fields.name_zh_en: Waiting time for registration or consultation is too long

fields.name_zh: 工作或家事太忙，沒有時間
fields.name_zh_en: Too busy with work or housework, no time

fields.name_zh: 家人沒有空帶您去看病
fields.name_zh_en: Family members don't have time to take you to see a doctor

fields.name_zh: 就算去看醫生也沒有用
fields.name_zh_en: Even going to see a doctor is useless

fields.name_zh: 沒有參加全民健保或健保卡遺失
fields.name_zh_en: Not enrolled in National Health Insurance, or NHI card lost

fields.name_zh: 自行服藥
fields.name_zh_en: self-administered medication

fields.name_zh: 害怕檢查結果，心裡會擔心
fields.name_zh_en: Afraid of the test result, feels worried

fields.name_zh: 其他原因
fields.name_zh_en: other reasons

fields.name_zh: "過去一年內"，您有沒有因為身體不舒服而到醫院掛急診呢？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", have you gone to the hospital emergency department because of feeling unwell?

fields.name_zh: "過去一年內"，您總共看過幾次急診？
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year", how many times in total have you been to the emergency room?

fields.name_zh: 緊急傷病
fields.name_zh_en: emergency illness

fields.name_zh: 一般門診未開診
fields.name_zh_en: General outpatient clinic not open

fields.name_zh: 掛不到該醫院的門診
fields.name_zh_en: Unable to get an outpatient appointment at that hospital

fields.name_zh: 覺得這樣比去門診較快能得到醫療服務
fields.name_zh_en: Feels this way medical service can be obtained faster than going to an outpatient clinic

fields.name_zh: 覺得這樣可以比較快得到住院病床
fields.name_zh_en: Feel that this way a hospital bed can be obtained faster

fields.name_zh: 其他
fields.name_zh_en: others

fields.name_zh: "過去一年內"，您有沒有住院過呢？【不包括住院接受健康檢查】
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year", have you been hospitalized? [Excluding hospitalization for a health examination]

fields.name_zh: "過去一年內"，您總共住院幾次？
fields.name_zh_en: "In the past year," how many times in total were you hospitalized?

fields.name_zh: "過去一年內"，您有沒有去找牙醫看過牙呢？
fields.name_zh_en: In the "past year", have you seen a dentist?

4:超過半年至一年內, 5:超過一年以上

fields.description_en: 1: Within the last 7 days, 2: More than 1 week to within 1 month, 3: More than 1 month to within 6 months, 4: More than 6 months to within 1 year, 5: More than 1 year

fields.name_zh: "過去一個月"，您"喝酒喝最多的一次"是喝什麼"酒"？
fields.description_zh:
1:啤酒/水果調味酒（如冰火）/涼酒等濃度5%以下的酒類,
2:維士比/保力達/藥酒類等濃度
6-10%的酒類,
3:玫瑰紅酒/紅、白葡萄酒/日本甜梅酒（choya）等濃度11-15%的酒類,
4:紹興酒/紅露酒/烏梅酒/台灣米酒等濃度16-20%的酒類,
5:參茸酒/鹿茸酒等濃度21-29%的酒類,
6:高梁酒/白蘭地/威士忌/伏特加/竹葉青/米酒頭等濃度30-49%的酒類,
7:高梁酒/茅台酒/玉山二鍋頭/特級高梁酒等濃度50%以上的酒類,
8:其他不知濃度無法歸類的酒類

fields.name_zh_en: [Interviewer check] Assessment of the respondent's level of consciousness

fields.description_zh:

4:公司裁員或關閉遷移等，被遣散, 5:收入不滿意,
6:生意失敗/經濟不景氣，利潤太差,
7:學生,
8:家庭因素：結婚或照顧家裡小孩子的關係, 9:其他因素

fields.description_en: 1: Retired or too old, 2: Health problems, unable to continue working, 3: Not suited to the job, 4: Laid off due to company downsizing/closure/relocation, 5: Dissatisfied with income, 6: Business failure/economic downturn, poor profits, 7: Student, 8: Family reasons: marriage or caring for children at home, 9: Other reasons

fields.description_en: 1: Full-time work, 2: Part-time work, 3: Student, 4: Other

fields.description_en: 1: Government employed, 2: Privately employed, 3: Self-employed (no employees), 4: Employer (has employees)

fields.description_en: 1: Fewer than 30 people, 2: 30 or more people

fields.name_zh_en: unemployment

fields.name_zh_en: find insurance premium too expensive

fields.name_zh_en: not insured after job change

fields.description_en:

fields.description_zh:
1:未滿3萬元, 2:3萬元～未滿5萬元,

[If given by parents or children who still live in the same household, do not count twice]
fields.description_en:
1: Less than 30,000 yuan, 2: 30,000 to less than 50,000 yuan,
3: 50,000 to less than 70,000 yuan,
4: 70,000 to less than 100,000 yuan, 5: 100,000 to less than 150,000 yuan, 6: 150,000 to less than 200,000 yuan,

fields.description_en:
1: Own work income, 2: Spouse's work income,
3: Old-age pension, retirement, survivor benefits, or insurance payments,
